text: Waaaargh!!!

text: It seems the Yeti is rather fond of those disgusting balls of fluff! You better find a way of discouraging him.

text: What do you think you're doing? Cease this barbaric slaughter, at once!

text: Please, can’t we just talk about this?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Continue to the camp and find out what that yeti’s up to.

text: Don’t forget, we still need a Spell Stone to give the Netherworld a bit of a kick in the pants!

text: It's Nordberg, the sleepy, snowy little town that was going to hand you over to the Empire!

text: Press <I=7> to switch between the two camera types

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hold <I=3> and move <I=26> to freely zoom and look around.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You can control both the Minions and the camera with <I=26>. To control the Minions first push forward, and then sweep them in the direction you want.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Push <I=26> left or right without first sweeping the Minions to rotate the camera. You can even do this whilst moving the Overlord.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Holding <I=6> brings up the Minion Select Panel. You can then press <I=10>, <I=11>, <I=12>, or <I=13> to select the corresponding Minion type.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: To quickly select all Minion types simply tap <l=6>

speaker: (unattributed)
text: To change the Minion and Mount Selection, hold <l=6> and tap <I=10> , <I=11>, <I=12>, or <I=13>. First press – all Minions of that type selected. Second press – only Mounted Minions of that type are selected. Third press – only non Mounted Minions of that type are selected.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Revisit conquered areas to harvest Lifeforce and treasure.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hold <I=11> to call back all your Minions.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t worry about lost Minions, they will automatically return to their Spawning Pit.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Utilizing different combinations of Minion types both on and off a Guard Marker can be an effective tactic. Try sending both Brown and Green Minions to attack a target. Or add Greens and Blues to a Red Minion Guard Marker.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Browns are melee fighters. Their policy is bash first, jump up and down on the carcass, later.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Use Browns to pin down fast moving enemies and fleeing peasants.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Position Browns on a Guard Marker using <I=13>. Do this in a bottleneck and they can stop enemies from breaking through and abusing your Dark Majesty.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Reds are fiery little blighters. Always handy if you fancy something roasted.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The more fire damage enemies take at once; the higher the chance they’ll catch fire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Keep your Reds out of melee and place them on high ground on a Guard Marker using <I=13>.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Greens are stealthy types. What they lack in hygiene they make up for in sneakiness.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Green Minions on a Guard Marker will cloak; making them invisible to enemies.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Greens have a powerful backstab attack. Make sure they approach enemies from behind.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Blues can swim and resurrect, but they’re less durable, so only order them to do bashing as a last resort.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Blues can swim.  Conquered levels might contain water-bound goodies that you weren’t able to get with your other Minions.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Place Blues on a Guard Marker in a safe spot (<I=13>) and make them auto-resurrect fallen Minions in the front line!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sweep (<I=26>) Blue Minions to make them blink past enemies.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sweeping Wolves gives them a temporary boost and is useful for breaking through Legion Formations.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Spiders can be placed on walls using a Guard Marker. These ambush points are impossible to reach for most enemies.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Salamanders enable Reds to fire whilst moving; so keep them rolling!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Walking up to a Netherworld Gate will restore your Health and Mana.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Observe enemies carefully. Often they will signal before an attack. Call your Minions back in time to avoid damage and follow up if the enemy has a weak spot.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Empire units in formation receive a defensive bonus and can’t be targeted individually.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Take out Centurions first to lower the morale of their formations. If their morale drops too low the formation will break up and the individual units will rout.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Some enemies can be directed to charge a target.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Tyranny affects how your Spells work.  Destruction Overlords become better at destroying things. Domination Overlords get better at dominating weak minded individuals.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Peasants under domination will slavishly follow you around and attack any hostile targets. Why waste Minions when plebs are available?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Subdue stray peasants (hold <I=12> + hold <I=5>), so they can act as an extra attack force or a handy diversion for enemies.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Although the Target spell (hold <I=12> + hold <I=5>) might not be enough to kill strong enemies on its own - it will slow them down.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Boost your Minions before sending them in a particularly challenging battle.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Use the Shockwave Spell when being surrounded by lots of pesky enemies.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Get to know all about your Minions by picking them up (Hold <I=12> + <I=8>) on the battlefield. Make sure you let go in time!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Minions are always ready to be sacrificed (Hold <I=12> + <I=8>) when the going gets tough for their Overlord.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Try resurrecting your favorite Minions at the Graveyard. You will need to pay the price in blood of lesser Minions, however.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Champion Minions might have developed special abilities, pay close attention!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: To fully conquer a town; hunt down all free townsfolk and determine their fate - death or domination.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Revisit towns to collect the goodies that the townsfolk have produced

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Explore the Netherworld. You might find some lost treasures the Minions have forgotten about.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Be good to your Mistress, even if you have more than one, and she’ll be good to you.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You can upgrade your Spells with Catalysts in the Magic Room in the Private Quarters.

text: Collect plenty of Lifeforce! You don’t want to use your best and most tooled up Minions as weapon ingredients.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Get to know your forged weapons. Some have bonuses associated with special strikes.

text: If she dies, the Sanctuary dies!

text: Help her!

text: Destroy the beast!

text: She’s is not well!

text: Our most glorious Queen must be preserved.

text: She is the lifeblood of the Sanctuary.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: She is too pure for you, man!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Dark One out! Dark One out!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Forgive me creatures of the Sanctuary.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It is the only way.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The poor thing. She’s gone quite, quite mad, Petunia!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We must save her.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: No, leave me! This is the only way!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Bring her here!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: No! No! Nooooooooo!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You don’t understand!

text: There, there, we won’t let the nasty man get you!

text: You just stay here with us, dearie.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I’m your Queen, listen to me!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: But you’re not very well, are you, dear? You need a lie down!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: And a nice cup of tea.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Let’s regroup Petunia!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: What is this feeling? Your... your dark energy. is taking me over. My light is fading!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I give my life...willingly.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh dear! It’s getting worse!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The nasty man is back!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Look you mad lumps, let me go this instant! I must do this!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Agggggggg!!!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Let me go you lipstick-smeared bats!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now, now, dearie, don’t get personal!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: She’s ranting. Pay no attention.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I’m trying to save the Sanctuary, you simple-minded creatures!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Well, you can’t do that if you’re dead, can you, dear?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Silly thing!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We’ll be back for you, dearie! Don’t worry!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The darkness... the evil... it’s all so ... beautiful.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Take my energy! You must... take it all! It is the only way!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh dear, now why are you letting the nasty man do that to you, dearie?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s not nice you know.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Unhand me before I rip off your wings and stick red-hot pokers in the holes!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: See, all that dark energy is no good for you! Come on!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hold them back and finish her off!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Are you really this stupid? Are you even hearing me?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You’re sick, dear. And we must help the sick and enfeebled, mustn’t we?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Yes, you can’t help it if the nasty man’s made your brain go all bibbly.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You idiotic creatures!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It is my choice!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Listen to your Queen, you amoebas!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There’s no helping some people!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s it! That’s it! Consume me with your dark majesty!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s it! That’s it! The darkness consumes me!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The end is coming. I can feel it. The darkness is overwhelming me!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: My end is near. The darkness is overwhelming. I will go to it.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I live... when so many others have died.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You have made me a... new woman, Dark One. I shall adjourn to your Tower, I will await your return... eagerly.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You‘re not going to let that thing in here are you? Brazen hussy!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Yeah! It’s always the former fairies you have to watch!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Mmm those that say three’s a crowd, probably haven’t made it further than one, Sire... I call it cosy.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: However, I think she still has a bit of energy left in her. You could drain her completely and kill her.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: She’s bound to contain some magical goodies. Or you could retain her in your Tower and see what other benefits she has.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: No, what are you doing? No, noooo!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ha Ha! We’re in men!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: When ooze falls from the sky it’s generally a good idea not be anywhere near it, Sire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I think it’s time to end this fairy killing adventure and head home.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Queeeen Fay?

speaker: (unattributed)

text: He is your ruler now and you will obey his every command.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our fiery friends are back with us, when will the fairies learn? In fighting Reds you'll end up dead and something's gonna burn!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Greens have come from the jungles deep. Where wind it never blows. It's not so swell to have the smell. Everybody hold you nose!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Blues are back in the evil fold. It’s true they had a fright. But Sire did thwart Arena foes. It was a splendid sight!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Feisty Kelda’s come to join us, she looks handy in a brawl. I hope she won’t cut off my head and mount it on the wall.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh Juno is a lovely sight. I'm almost moved to tears. I hope she will sit down with me and gently stroke my ears!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Sanctuary has been destroyed, Dark Fay has come to play! We may need more black velvet if she is going to stay!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Sanctuary has been destroyed, and Queenie made a fuss. And now we got to pay the price, her ghost’s moved in with us!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire is Tyrant of Nordberg, feared by one and all! No one can stand against him and those who try will fall!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hail Tyrant of Everlight, who made the Empire quail! There’s no one left to face you down who is not bound to fail!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Lord he has been building. Let’s hope it’s not a fad. Foreboding, dark and heinous, it’s quite the evil pad!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The ladies love a big 'un, the dark and looming power. And now he’s built his own one, he’s Tyrant of the Tower!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Lord he loves to dominate, subversion is the key. All around do fear him, the land’s on bended knee!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Master loves destruction, the sound of screams and fear. For every soul that he cuts down, we Minions give a cheer.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire did slay the fluffy beasts, they didn’t have a prayer. Now they’ll make a nice warm muff. Our Lord the Seal Slayer!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Arena has been rocking, our Lord he loves to fight. The Minions flock to see ‘cos violence makes their night!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: He’s Lord of the Arena. All foes he did ably crush. I hope he doesn’t turn on me and make Quaver into mush!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: He’s hunted down the little pests, their pointy hats did run. There’s nothing like a gnome on fire to make for evil fun!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Lord he likes to save his gold, to spend it would be vile. Instead he likes to look at it, he has a great big pile!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: His carnage is impressive. Of that there is no doubt. The rock did fly right through the air, one strike and they were out!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Life force has been gathered. Our Minions spring to work. They’ll obey their Master. The killings just a perk!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: With three ladies in the Tower, we feared it would be hell. But the Lord did sooth their savage ways and they all got on so well!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Kelda came from Nordberg, to our Tower she did descend. Our Lord won her affection, now he’s her special friend.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh Juno is an Empire gal, she’s elegant and sleek. She showed our Lord exotic ways, I swear I didn’t peak!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now Fay’s heart’s been corrupted, she’s got that evil spark. And when she closed the curtains, they both embrace the dark!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Fay is quite the temptress, though her time alive is done. She took our Lord to spiritual heights, the dead can have fun!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Master saved his Minion crew from spider webs so icky. Now they’re back to fight again, I hope they’re not too sticky!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There was a boy from the Nordberg Town who sent the locals screaming. But now the boy’s become a man, he’ll start his evil scheming!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire has mastered forging, he’s now prepared for battle. He’ll inspire fear and loathing and cause teeth and bones to rattle!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Tower Heart we thought was lost, it’d taken quite a knock. But now the Master’s pieced it back, it’ll give our foes a shock.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Master has claimed Nordberg, a land of snow and ice. And now he will take sweet revenge, he’s naughty, he’s not nice!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Everlight was an Empire playground, a place of great excess. And now our Lord has conquered it, their tourist trap’s a mess!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire did kill the Spider Queen, her reign of terror ends. The Greens are very happy, cos we’ve got her little friends!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Salamander King is dead! He’s just a piece of meat. The Reds are celebrating, cos his mounts will save their feet!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Lord did crash the commune and captured them like bugs. They shall not run from him again. He’s got no time for hugs!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Lord did crush the commune and squashed them all like bugs. None shall run from him again. He’s got no time for hugs!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The tarpits are all burning, the sky has been turned black. The seas have started rising, global warming’s right on track!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our captain manned a mighty ship and sailed us through the straits. With his merry rowing Minions he discovered Elven gates!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Master killed a panda, a horrid, fluffy beast. If I knew how to cook one, we’d have a giant feast!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Master’s been to the Wastelands, Once our Minion home. Now it’s where the magic’s soured and oozing beasts do roam!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Evil Presence is with us, my very favorite spell! Make them fall upon their knees or send their bones to hell.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Master has a Halo, to buff his army vast. Or turn that feisty spell on him and cause himself to blast!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now Master can grab a Minion and send it to attack. Or use the fellow to buff himself with a light Minion snack!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now Sire did find a Sanctuary, a place of magic light. He smashed it up, he smashed it down and had a real good smite!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire did slay a winged one! I don’t know how they fly. They seem too round to leave the ground and ever reach the sky!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Those Elven soldiers are finished, why does the earth cry out in pain? With those poor saps out of the way, she’s everything to gain!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now Sire has found some wolven friends, there is no looking back. With his Browns aboard their steeds, he’s leader of the pack!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Poor Quaver he does sing alone, sad times he had to weather. But now our Lord has looted Elves, he’s got a band together!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire performed an unholy act, a Minion he did possess. Thankfully he let it go, before there was a mess!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Master slayed the Yeti fierce, he really was a thug. And I think we all agree, he looks better as a rug!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Those tourists tried to run, from the Master’s evil reign! But our Lord did track them down and brought them back again!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Those tourists tried to run, and got themselves a boat. But Master sent it sinking down, I wonder can they float?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The rebels tried to stir things up, and blow Everlight apart. But now they’re slaves, just like the rest, it wasn’t very smart!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The rebels tried to stir things up, and blow Everlight apart. But now they’re food for bugs and worms, it wasn’t very smart!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Lord subdued the Yeti fierce, he really was a thug. Master has him as a pet, he’d be better as a rug!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sire slew the Devourer, before it could eat the town. Now folks all call him Emperor for beating that blob down!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Explore the Netherworld further or take the tunnel to the Ice Caves where I’ve set up a few tests to gauge your true Overlord potential.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I’m far too old for gallivanting and those Nordberg winds go right up my nethers, so I shall stay here; warm my bones with a little hell fire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t worry you’ll have Quaver, our Bard, and some Browns with you.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Besides, your helmet allows me to hear and see what you do. And I bet you thought it was just a hat!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Minion Burrows are believed to be the birth place of the First Minion: He who dug his way to the surface to serve the very First Overlord.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: After we, um, lost our last Master and before the Great Cataclysm decimated the old lands, we retreated here in the Exodus.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Here we’ve remained, searching for our next bastion of evil!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Minion Mortis is in charge, that is to say he facilitates your decisions, Sire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Spawns new Minions, tends the souls of the dead, makes sure they don’t come back with the wrong head, that sort of thing.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Minions. We live. We serve. We die. It is what we are and what we will always be.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Barracks. The spawning place. You bring me Lifeforce, I bring you Minions.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Barracks are where Minions live when they’re not out causing chaos with you, Sire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s also where we keep the Hives, which allow Minion summoning.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Unfortunately, during the Exodus several Minion Hives were lost. We only managed to retain the Browns.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I’m sure they’d love a visit.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Here be Browns! Browns are strong and loyal. They live to fight!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s right, Mortis.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Browns are your main melee fighters due to their attitude of hit first... jump up and down on the carcass, later!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: No Red Minions.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Mortis misses the Reds; He used to let them roast rats on his scythe.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: They were lured away by wisps! Daft creatures! But we believe they’re living in a volcanic area nearby.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Well the place is a little less drafty with our Reds back. They have a powerful ranged attack, Sire, and can also absorb fire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Greens Gone.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Greens left during the Exodus. They said they smelt something reeking and split from the main group.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: They’re such stealthy types, we blinked and they were gone.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Talk in the Spawning Pit says they’ve made their home on a jungle island.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ah the Greens; it’s almost nice to have the smell back. They are stealthy assassins, Master, with a ferocious backstab attack.

speaker: (unattributed)

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This damp spot is reserved for the Blues.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Their magical inclination meant they felt most lost without an Overlord to guide them. They retreated to the nearest watery area.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Strange fellows. We have no idea what’s happened to them.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Well, Sire, the Blues don’t seem too bothered by their spell in the Arena.

speaker: (unattributed)

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I have assembled the artifact, Dark One, but it has very little power left.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Empire seek to force their way into the Last Sanctuary and from there into your realm.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: If you really believe this can strike a decisive blow against Solarius, then I give you permission to charge it with energy from my four shrines in the lower caves.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Alas, this will mean the destruction of the creatures that live there.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Wow, I’m glad I don’t live in her domain!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Grave decisions must be made during a time of war, but I pray they will not suffer too long.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I hope that this object is worth Florian’s life.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I fear he is not long for this world - Especially if he is put in Solarius’ vile Arena!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Couldn’t happen to a nicer chap!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Go, we don’t have long before they break through.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Get the Minions to carry the Towerheart to the shrine and let’s juice this thing up!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now use your Evil Presence spell on the crystal to transfer its energy into the Towerheart.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Keep holding the spell until all the energy is transferred, Lord. Don’t waste a drop.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh no, your little ball thingy! Shame, it looked like it was going to be so shiny, as well.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I could’ve used it as my throne and sat on top of it like a Queen.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Think you’d look much better under it!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hmm, either way Sire you must get the Towerheart back. It’s not fully charged yet!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s landed in the middle of a Gnome village, Sire. With any luck it’s squashed a few of the stunted little squelchers!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Get it back before they start trying to live in it!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s it, Gnomies, if in doubt run away! Right let’s find the next shrine, Sire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Better find something to cover that hole, Sire. No one needs an exploding Gnome stuck to them.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Good! Best place for them. Get going before they dig their way out!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hurry, I don’t want the soldiers getting into the Netherworld. There’s a bit too much Empire in here as it is.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Bring the Towerheart to the shrine, Master.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now cast your Evil presence spell on the crystal.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hold that spell, Lord. We’ll need all the energy from the shrine.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s a gift from the earth.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Woooooooowww. A shiny gift.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Quick. We must bring it to the others.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: By my hairy black toes, they’re salamanders! Ancient creatures that live deep within the earth where it’s warmest.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The shrine must have been protecting their lair.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The gases within the bellies of these fiery fellows make them extremely unstable, especially when damaged.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: When that happens it’s just best to stay out of their way until the explosions have subsided!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: All clear, Sire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: If you could find some way of bringing those lizards around to *ahem* our way of thinking, Lord, they might make suitable mounts for your Reds.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Bring the Towerheart to the shrine, Master.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s our shiny thing, we found it, man!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: And we’re not going to let you use it to destroy the shrines and the pretty creatures!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Our Queen clearly doesn’t know bad vibes when she sees them!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Leave them alone you bully!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh no, he’s bringing us down!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ha ha! No shiny thing for you!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You leave us no choice!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We’ll have to hurt you!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Order your Minions to carry the Towerheart near to the shrine.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Cast your Evil presence spell on the crystal and let’s suck it dry!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You broke the spell too early, Master. Try again, we need all that crystal’s energy.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s a salamander King! He must be controlling the other salamanders.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: And he’s making off with the Towerheart! Fay really should have better control over her creature. Send a memo out!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Still there’s something about the Towerheart that brings out the thief in everyone.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: No time to become the King’s favourite toy, Sire. Get out of there!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Enough playing about, Master, there’s Empire at the door! We need that Towerheart back fast!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Perhaps you can find a way to cool him down a little?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now’s your chance! Give him a good hard smack and get our Towerheart!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Quick Lord, Make with the cold shower again!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Keep on that lizard’s tail... and then chop it off! Chop anything you like off. Just kill it!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now finish him and we can get the Towerheart and control of his little fireball friends.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: A few fire-breathing salamanders on our side should send the Empire running!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You’ll have to smash the head, Sire. Shame, would’ve looked good in my rockery next to the petrified succubus.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ah, such a shame... wonderful woman, before the, er, incident.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: See, they’re not attacking now. You’re their new King! I’m sure the Reds will be happy they don’t have to walk everywhere.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Keep moving, Sire. One more shrine to go! And lots more Empire to crush!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Drat! They’re breaking through! Quickly! Keep them out of the Sanctuary, Master!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Saddle up your Reds and sweep the salamanders over the ramp!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Use your salamanders on that ramp and keep moving. That way they can set those soldiers on fire, without being damaged.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: A drive by flaming!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t forget to keep your salamanders moving and flaming, Sire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Use your salamanders on the Gnome holes. Get some flames up the parts only their mothers see!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t leave the Towerheart behind, Sire. There seems no shortage of beasties that want to thieve it!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: What have you done with the Towerheart, Sire? You need to bring it to the shrine.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now let’s see a bit of Evil Presence on that crystal!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Try again and this time, make sure you drain all the energy from the crystal.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s the last of the shrines. Hmmm, still doesn’t seem like it’s got enough pep yet!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Move it, Sire and head back to Queenie, sharpish. Perhaps with the Empire breaking through her roof, there’s more of this sanctuary she’d like to sacrifice!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ah, these lands were once the location of the Dark Tower - The seat of Overlording power!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: At least until your predecessor mysteriously disappeared during a trip to the Infernal Abyss.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Without an Overlord the Minions fled to the Netherworld.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: After the Great Cataclysm ruined the Dark Tower, we never returned.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: See for yourself. Magic is running rampant here! Unrestrained!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: And Minions are rather partial to not being turned inside out or growing an extra head!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Unless it’s in the service of our Overlord, of course!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This place is said to be the source of the Great Cataclysm and a magical plague, which swept the land many years ago.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Although no one is quite sure what caused it.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You should explore, Lord. These lands once held many secrets and artifacts  which may now aid you against the Empire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ah, this looming fortress was once the source of fear and brown trousers in this land.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: But whatever caused the Cataclysm has reduced it to ruins.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This was once your spawning pit, Sire. Well, it was where your evil seed was planted, as it were.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Your spawn-mother left before you were born.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: She didn’t feel that a Dark Tower was the right place to bring up a baby. Strange female!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Until the Browns found you in Nordberg, we thought we’d lost you forever. See there’s no restraining true Evil. It’s in the blood!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: By my claws, that’s a shard of the old Towerheart!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Towerheart collects magical energy and grows in power with its Overlord.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: With the old Overlord gone, the magical energy within it should have gradually dispelled.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: But it appears to have exploded for some reason! So that’s what caused the Great Cataclysm!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: See if you can locate the other shards of the Towerheart, Sire. Maybe there’s some magical energy left.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: If the Towerheart exploded and caused the Cataclysm, then no wonder all that pent up energy resulted in a magical plague.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It had no Overlord to be absorbed into!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Just look at what it’s done to the flora and fauna around here. That magical ooze looks particularly potent.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It may have odd side effects on your Minions. Send one into it and see what happens.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Er, I wouldn’t send one of your favourites, just in case.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh dear! He’s mutated and out of control! Let’s not do that again.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: After the magical plague the locals didn’t take kindly to magical folk. Seems even the surviving Halflings were drummed out of their homes.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Mind you, no one likes having Halflings around at the best of times!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: These are dark crystals; Pure evil energy that’s become crystallized.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Very powerful and very rare, Sire. You may find them useful.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That ooze is blocking your way, Sire. It’s not safe for your Minions to cross.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Maybe if we had the Blue Minions, they might be able to resist it, being much more magically inclined.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You should try and locate them, Sire. In the meantime, I suggest you continue your diabolical deeds elsewhere.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Master, we’ll need the Blues to continue.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Of course, if you can’t resist exploring some more I shall refresh your knowledge of these lands.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t go forward without the Blues, Lord. If you wish to, you can explore the safe areas some more and I can refresh your memory about these lands.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Now, let’s see if our little jaunt to the Arena to fetch back the Blues was worth it!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Try sending a Blue Minion into the ooze.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ah, as I thought their magic is pushing back the ooze. Be quick, Sire, I doubt it’ll stay away for long.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This ooze... hmmm it must be what happens when large quantities of magic are released into the world and  there’s no appropriate host nearby.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s soured magic, Sire. No good to anyone.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You should venture further into the domain and continue to search for shards of the Towerheart.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hmm, are these barriers to keep something in or keep something out?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Either way, they won’t be stopping you, Great One!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The explosion of the Towerheart decimated the entire area, including the old Dark Tower.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I guess they didn’t call it a Cataclysm for nothing!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There’s another Towerheart shard, Lord! Free it from that ooze.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Where did it go?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Must have a base around here.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Think it’s the one we’re meant to be looking for?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Yeah, cos I’d hate to think we’d stumbled upon the wrong secret base!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This is it! They’ve sent the Demon Lord of Nordberg to finish us off!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Look, we’ve got enough problems, ok?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: They kicked us out of the City; claimed that we were contaminated with magic. Ridiculous!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Or we no longer “fitted” in the Glorious Empire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: They dumped us here to die! Arrrrgggg.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Get back.... Get back. Stay away from me!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Aggg! He’s mutated!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: No time for pleasantries ... not that I have anything pleasant to say to you…

speaker: (unattributed)
text: A large force of Empire troops is heading this way.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I come on behalf of Queen Fay to offer you against my better judgement, a truce. If you agree follow me to the Last Sanctuary.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I take no joy that our paths have crossed again, but it appears we share a common enemy - One who is as relentless as they are powerful.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I speak of Solarius’ Empire.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: His forces are too great for either of us to fight alone…

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh, let me guess... now she wants to be friends!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: But together we may stand a chance.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There! No one ever suggests being friends when they’re dripping with gold and jewels!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I know what you seek in these lands. If you agree to join forces I will send my lieutenant Florian to aid you.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Help finding the Towerheart shards would be useful, Sire. I guess we can always kill him afterwards!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Follow me then, Scourge of Nature, let’s go!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You appear to have overlooked a few shards on your way, here, Scourge. Honestly I have to do everything myself!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This is what you get when you disrespect nature!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: All nature’s animals are beautiful to me... apart from those little freaks of yours!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Yuck! See how evil has sneezed across the perfect face of Mother Nature!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The balance must be maintained!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Such things assault my eyes. Yet I shall be strong!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Squash it! I mean usher it gently to the next world.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Come on. We know how good you are at destroying things!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s regime of oozing terror must be stopped!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Strike it from my sight!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Come on!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Hmm, not bad, Scourge of Nature! Let us continue.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: If I die you will never find your precious Towerheart shards!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Leave me alone. I will not be persecuted by the likes of you!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I am not the enemy!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Cease your actions!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Do not seek my destruction!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Uncool man, uncool!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The man... the man’s oppressing me!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t mess with my mojo.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I don’t like your negative vibes!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: What’s with all the aggression, man?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Sheath your weapon at once!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You’re really bringing me down!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Leave me alone!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Harsh! Harsh!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We’re on the same side!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Are you happy now?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Do concentrate on the task in hand, Sire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: He has returned to the earth.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I know killing them is very tempting, Lord, but there are other pressing matters to attend to!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: He’s dead! He’s dead!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Don’t kill the Elves, Sire. They make good meat shields!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Why must you torment us, man?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: At the moment these Elves are more useful to us alive than dead, Master!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Well there goes the battle fodder!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I have found a piece!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Just like horrible pointy-eared sniffer dogs, Sire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Here! Look, beast!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Why do the hard work yourself, when you can get Elves to do it for you?

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Here’s one!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There’s a good Elf doggie!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Over here, Scourge.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: I hope he doesn’t want you to scratch him behind his ears!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The remaining shards are behind this gate, I will open it for you!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There’s the last piece. Secure it and we can return to the Sanctuary.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That oozy thing has our Towerheart shard, Master. Show it what we do to oozy things around here!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: They’ve found us! They’ve found us! We’re doomed. DOOMED!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: This is the end!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: They’ve come for us!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh woe is me... woe, wwwooooeee!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We are finished!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: It’s that Elf outlaw!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Mercy! Mercy! Please have mercy!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We have no need for mercy... Elf... we have justice... to the Arena with him!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Nooooo! Nooooo! Queeeeeen Fay! Save me, save me!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Oh well, I guess that’s one Arena fight that won’t last too long! Saves you having to kill him!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: At least we have all the shards. They’re gathered in the Sanctuary. You better return there... fast!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: After him! After him!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Death to the magical demons!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Destroy all magic!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Solarius will bring the light!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: All magic must be wiped out.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: The Empire will prevail!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Leave no demon alive!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Find the Sanctuary!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Wipe them out!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Kill the Elf! Kill the Elf friends!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You cannot hide from Solarius!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We will bring the might of the Empire down upon you!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: For the Empire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: He is in league with the Elves!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: You may hide in the earth. But we will find you!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There’s no where you can go that we can’t follow!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Ha! They’re actually trying to gang up against us!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We will breach the Last Sanctuary.

speaker: (unattributed)
text: For Solarius!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Kill them! Kill them all!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: We’ll get you back in the Arena!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Archers, fire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Fire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: There they are, fire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Shoot at will!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: That’s them! Fire!

speaker: (unattributed)
text: Shoot them down!
